title: Read deadlines never panic on a huge timeout and stop at every long read phase, including active-change loading and before the bulk archive listing
description: Read deadlines never panic on a huge timeout and stop at every long read phase, including active-change loading and before the bulk archive listing
acceptance_criteria: a_timeout_too_large_for_the_clock_reads_normally passes: --timeout or SPECSYNC_TIMEOUT too large to add to the clock means no deadline, never a panic (failing first in ebe614da)

change_list_past_its_timeout_stops_while_loading_active_changes passes: loading active changes is a phase with a deadline boundary (active change loading), so a read past its deadline exits 124 with that phase (failing first in ebe614da)

an_expired_deadline_stops_the_archive_index_before_it_lists_anything passes: the archive-introduction index checks its deadline before its bulk diff-tree listing, including when there is no commit to loop over (failing first in ebe614da)
The workflow-version history walk checks the deadline between commits; a worker that sees it stops and the command thread reports, as REQ-change-137 already does
Without a deadline nothing changes; the report shape, exit 124, the cache flush and every refusal are unchanged

answers.constraints: SPEED-1 (no command keeps an agent waiting minutes); REQ-change-137 (deadline semantics: stop at a phase boundary, flush completed verdicts, write nothing) and REQ-cmd-change-032 stay; a worker never reports, it stops and lets the command thread report
